brique._comment: Engine-native Matter family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: structure.clone
objective.description: Clone one existing local structure descriptor into a new local target structure.

#root.role: Resolve a source structure and a target structure identifier, duplicate the source descriptor, and register the cloned target in the local catalog.

source_structure_id._comment: Required. Name of the source structure (without .json extension).

target_structure_id._comment: Optional. Name of the clone. Auto-generated if absent.

destination_ctx_id._comment: Optional. Absolute context path (from /root) for the clone. Defaults to the addressed context.

effects.source_descriptor: The source structure descriptor is read.
effects.target_descriptor: A new target structure descriptor is written.
effects.catalog: The local structure catalog gains the cloned target.

transformation_contract.morphing: A source structure identity plus a target structure identity becomes a new committed target structure descriptor copied from the local source and registered in the local catalog.
invariants: When cloning within the same context (no destination_ctx_id, or destination_ctx_id equal to the addressed context), source_structure_id and target_structure_id must identify distinct structures.
When cloning to a different context, source_structure_id and target_structure_id may be identical, since the destination context is a distinct namespace.
The source structure must already exist in the local runtime catalog before cloning begins.
Cloning duplicates the local descriptor only; there is no separate substance plane for structures.
success: On success, structure.clone returns ok=true, the source_structure_id, the concrete target_structure_id, and the committed revision of the target.
Successful cloning writes a new target structure descriptor and registers it in the local catalog.
failure: The capacity fails when source_structure_id is missing.
The capacity fails when source_structure_id and target_structure_id are identical and the clone is within the same context.
The capacity refuses cloning when the source structure is absent or the destination structure_id already exists in the runtime catalog.
The capacity fails when the source descriptor is unreadable, invalid JSON, or cannot be committed for the target.
notes: If target_structure_id is omitted, the engine generates a fresh local destination identifier.
If destination_ctx_id is provided, the clone is written into that context instead of the addressed context; the destination context must already exist.
